en: If you had to describe how you’re feeling right now in three words, what would they be?
When you experience strong or overwhelming emotions, how do you usually deal with them?
Are there any emotions that you tend to keep inside or avoid expressing? If so, what makes you hold them back?
Are there particular situations, thoughts, or experiences that tend to trigger stress or anxiety for you?
What do you do to take care of your emotional well-being when you’re feeling stressed or emotionally tired?
When you start overthinking, how do you usually handle it? Does it make it harder for you to relax or switch off your mind?
When you have self-critical thoughts, how do you usually deal with them? How do they affect the way you see yourself?
How do you usually decide whether a thought is helpful, unhelpful, appropriate, or worth letting go of?
How does the way you talk to yourself affect your motivation, determination, and ability to keep going when things get difficult?
In what ways do you think your past has shaped your personality, beliefs, or the way you see life?
Do you still feel the impact of any important or difficult experiences from your past today?
Is there a memory from your childhood that still affects you emotionally today?
How does the way you see your own worth and your ability to give or receive love affect your emotional well-being?
How do your past relationships—both good and bad—affected the way you trust and connect with people today?
When two of your beliefs seem to conflict with each other, how do you usually find a sense of balance?
How do you make sure you get enough sleep, and how important is sleep in your daily routine?
When you face setbacks or find it difficult to maintain your healthy habits, how do you usually respond?
What do you do to maintain a healthy balance between work, studies, responsibilities, and personal time? How does this balance affect how you feel?
How do you deal with uncertainty or not knowing exactly what the future holds?
How do you make sure that the future you’re planning for will actually make you feel fulfilled and satisfied?
